name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
March 23, 2010
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - The Reverend Michael Carr of All Saints Episcopal Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring April 2010 "Child Abuse Prevention Month" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Proclamations to outgoing Miss Pride of Vista and Miss Teen Tri City and introduction of the new courts.
P3.
Proclamation declaring April 2010 "Fair Housing Month" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending January 31, 2010 (CC)
C4.
Fire Station No. 1 Increase in Change Order Authority (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , amending the Capital Improvement Program for the FY 2009/10; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , increasing the City Manager's change order authority for the Vista Fire Station No. 1 project by $50,000.
C5.
California Gang Reduction, Intervention, and Prevention Grant (CC)
C6.
Special Event Banner Program - 2010 Calendar Year Update (CC)
C7.
Amendment to Keyser Marston Associates Economic Consulting Services Agreement (CDC)
C8.
Engineer's Reports for FY 2010-2011 Levy of Assessments (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , for the City of Vista Landscaping and Lighting District No. 1;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , for the City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , for the South Melrose Landscape Maintenance District.
C9.
Catalyst Project Application (CC)
C10.
Buena Vista Creek Walk Project Agreement (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
2010-2011 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Annual Action Plan (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing, and
2.
Open the 30-day public review period for the proposed 2010-2011 Annual Action Plan to solicit community input.
PH2.
Downtown Specific Plan (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , certifying the Final Program Environmental Impact Report for the Downtown Specific Plan, and adopting Environmental Findings and a Statement of Overriding Considerations pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving a General Plan amendment to change the land use designation on 352 acres from Central Business District (CBD), Commercial Neighborhood (CN), General Commercial (GC), High Density Residential (HD), Medium High Density Residential (MHD), and Medium Low Density Residential (MLD) to Specific Plan Area (SPA), and change the land use designation on 4 acres from CBD to Medium Density Residential (MD); and (Recommendation continued on following page)
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2010- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Changing the Zoning from Specific Plan 26, Commercial (C-1 and C-2), Multi-Family Residential (R-M(15) and R-M(21)), and Residential (R-1) to Specific Plan Implementation (SPI) on 352 Acres, a Zone Change from Specific Plan 26 to Residential (R-1-B) on 4 Acres, Repeal of Specific Plan No. 26, and Adoption of the Downtown Specific Plan."
PH3.
2005-2012 Housing Element (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving a Negative Declaration for the 2005-2012 Housing Element; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , adopting the 2005-2012 Housing Element of the General Plan.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
